{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: generate_ui — the model authors A2UI documents rendered as interactive surfaces in the chat (valuz genui)","id":"gh:1336774522","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-valuz-genui","slug":"valuz-ai/dsh-valuz-genui","topics":["a2ui","dsh-plugin","generative-ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: generate_ui — the model authors A2UI documents rendered as interactive surf"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"aces in the chat (valuz genui)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-valuz-genui"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives the model a `generate_ui` tool: the **model itself authors** an"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" A2UI v0.9.1 document and passes it to `generate_ui`, and the browser renders it as an **interactive"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" surface inline in the chat** — charts, KPI cards, tables, forms, dashboards — **streaming as the mo"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"del writes the call**, and whose interactions come back to the model."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"There is **no nested model call**: the UI is the model's own streamed output, so it appears live (li"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ke a fenced block), costs one model turn, and can't fail with a mid-stream error from a second reque"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"st. It builds on the provider-agnostic valuz-genui core (76-component A2UI catalog, streaming saniti"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"zer, React renderer)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Authoring guide (system prompt + skill).** The plugin teaches the model to author A2UI and deliv"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"er it by calling `generate_ui` with `messages` (the array of A2UI message objects). When the host su"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"pports skills, a compact guide (component names + purposes + message contract) is always on and the "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"full field-signature catalog loads on demand via the `genui` skill; otherwise the full guide stays i"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"n the system prompt.
- **Streaming render.** As the model writes the `generate_ui` arguments, each `"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"tool-call-delta` reaches the browser as a transient `assistant/live-chunk` *before the tool runs*. A"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" conversation node keyed by the `generate_ui` call id folds those deltas, extracts the complete A2UI"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" messages authored so far, and renders them with the valuz `<A2UIRenderer>` — which keeps the last g"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ood surface while the tail is still being written. So the surface builds up component by component, "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"live.
- **Settle + replay.** When `generate_ui` executes (milliseconds — it only validates and never"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" calls a model), it persists the canonical document to `tool/result.meta`. The node adopts that auth"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"oritative document. Live chunks are process-local and disappear when the model attempt settles, so a"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"fter settling and on reload the node rebuilds from the durable `tool/call` arguments and `tool/resul"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"t.meta`.
- **Turn end.** When the turn completes, its settled surfaces render again after the final "},{"id":"p6s15","text":"reply, outside dsh's collapsed process view, and the in-process copy shrinks to a one-line reference"},{"id":"p6s16","text":".
- **Interactions.** A click/submit on a rendered surface is sent back to the model as an ordinary "},{"id":"p6s17","text":"user message: `<ui_action surface="…" component="…" name="…">{context}</ui_action>` (model-visible ⟺"},{"id":"p6s18","text":" logged). The model answers in text or calls `generate_ui` again with the updated document."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Compatibility"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Plugin | DeepSeek Harness |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| 0.2.x | 0.2.x (from 0.2.0-rc.2) |
| 0.1.x | 0.1.0-rc.6 to 0.1.1 |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"dsh 0.2 replaced the client Conversation APIs that 0.1.x uses, so 0.1.x fails to load there with `pe"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"nding (waiting for service: conversationEvents)`. dsh checks a plugin's declared peer ranges at inst"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"all and startup, so an incompatible pairing is refused before it loads."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Into an existing profile that already has a model configured:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The npm package ships a prebuilt `lib/`, so no build step or `allowBuilds` entry is needed. To pin a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"n unreleased commit instead, install from git — pnpm ≥ 10 then blocks the git dependency's `prepare`"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" build until you allow it; the first `add` fails and prints the exact key to copy into the profile's"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh. Ask the model for a chart or dashboard to verify. **No extr"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"a configuration is needed** — the model authors the UI through whatever model the session is using."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Local development"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The generation core and renderer come from npm (`@valuz/genui-core`, `@valuz/a2ui`, from valuz-ai/va"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"luz-genui); the client bundle inlines them at build time:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh after each rebuild."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## The tool"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`generate_ui(messages, title?)`"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- `messages` — the array of A2UI v0.9.1 message objects the model authored: `createSurface` first, t"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"hen `updateComponents` / `updateDataModel`; exactly one component has id `"root"`. Written as native"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" JSON (not a stringified blob), so it streams and validates cleanly.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Placement inside completed turns.** dsh folds a completed turn's process (skill load, reasoning,"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" tool calls) into a collapsed "Completed in Ns" disclosure. The plugin therefore shows a completed t"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"urn's settled surfaces at the end of the turn, after the final reply, through dsh's `conversation.ch"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"at.turnTail` slot, and replaces each surface inside the process with a one-line reference. A later s"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"urface with the same title counts as a revision, so only the latest one appears at the turn's end; s"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"urfaces with different titles all appear. A surface that never settled (for example, an interrupted "},{"id":"p26s7","text":"call) stays inside the process.
- **Always-on prompt cost.** Where the host supports skills (`ctx.sk"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"ills`, e.g. the web profile), only a compact guide (~3.1k tokens: component names + one-line purpose"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"s + the message contract) stays always on, and the full field-signature catalog (~9k tokens) loads o"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"n demand through the `genui` skill. Where no skill capability exists (or `alwaysOnFullGuide: true`),"},{"id":"p26s11","text":" the full guide stays in the system prompt. Both are stable prefixes (KV-cache-friendly). The model "},{"id":"p26s12","text":"is told to load the `genui` skill before authoring; guessing fields drops components.
- **Authoring "},{"id":"p26s13","text":"quality depends on the model.** A2UI's 76-component graph is richer — and harder to author inline — "},{"id":"p26s14","text":"than a compact DSL. Complex dashboards may need prompt tuning; the sanitizer tolerates and drops mal"},{"id":"p26s15","text":"formed components rather than failing the whole surface.
- **Client bundle is large (~3.5 MB).** rec"},{"id":"p26s16","text":"harts, the A2UI renderer, and markdown-it are inlined. Phase 2 splits the chart engine into a lazily"},{"id":"p26s17","text":" loaded plugin-served asset.
- **Theme bridge is coarse.** The renderer follows light/dark but does "},{"id":"p26s18","text":"not yet map A2UI `--va2-*` tokens onto the host `--dsw-alias-*` scale. Core semantic tokens (backgro"},{"id":"p26s19","text":"und, text, border, accent) can be mapped through a registered a2ui theme extension; chart palettes l"},{"id":"p26s20","text":"ive in JS and need renderer support.
- **Interactions round-trip through the model.** Every `<ui_act"},{"id":"p26s21","text":"ion>` becomes a user message; there is no local-only handling yet.
